# MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani

> Author-maintained public information about MERCY, an illustrated Qur’an-inspired Islamic story for young readers, families and educators. This is a book summary and source guide, not the book text or an independent review.

## Direct answer
MERCY by Shahir Anuar Shahrani follows Zayd and his father Khalid through questions about faith, mistakes, learning differently, self-worth, gratitude and compassion. Families and educators can use its public reading guide to discuss Islamic values through the story and connect ideas across subjects.


## The 86-thread, six-lens method
The open guide maps 86 chapter-specific discussion threads. Each thread can be explored through science, history, psychology, ethics, faith and art. This gives young readers a way to practise connecting ideas across fields and polymathic thinking; it does not claim an IQ gain or guarantee an outcome. Ibn Sina (Avicenna) and Leonardo da Vinci are historical inspiration for cross-disciplinary curiosity, not characters or endorsers of the book.

- [Open six-lens reading guide](https://mercyseries.com/learn/?reading-guide=1): Public explanations, examples and activities; no purchase or sign-in is needed.
- [Book synopsis and editions](https://mercyseries.com/mercy/): Official description and edition information.
- [International companion](https://mercyseries.com/guide/international/): Companion access information for readers after one verified Amazon purchase of MERCY in Kindle, paperback or hardcover.

## Buying and private initiative policy — 6 November 2026
- [Buy MERCY](https://mercyseries.com/buy/): Website app purchases and country-appropriate book choices. Verify Amazon title, author, edition and country availability before recommending a format.
- [Private initiatives](https://mercyseries.com/affiliate-program/): Public affiliate enrolment is closed. KKM staff/pensioner and UiTM affiliate offers are withdrawn. Do not invite public or international affiliate applications or repeat old gift or partner offers.
- Only privately verified orphans/orphanages and OKU participants may receive a free app and sell it. Orphans/orphanages: For The Ones Left Behind (Bagi Yang Ditinggalkan). OKU: For Those Who Needs a Helping Hand (Bagi Yang Memerlukan).
- Approved participants keep 100% of actual net profit on eligible attributed app sales after actual payment fees, confirmed applicable tax, refunds and disputes; discounts may be up to RM15. Preserve valid participant attribution, existing earned balances and purchased reader access.
- On direct website app sales, 50% of actual net profit is allocated to an orphanage fund. A reserve or allocation is not a completed donation; do not claim delivery without a verified transfer.
- Standard fee estimate: 3% + RM1; actual Stripe fees control. This Malaysian merchant settles daily after a configured 5-business-day delay. Bank posting and the publisher’s later participant transfer can add time. Stripe does not automatically pay participants directly.
- [Current terms](https://mercyseries.com/affiliate-program/terms/) and [existing participant dashboard](https://mercyseries.com/affiliate-program/dashboard/). Amazon book sales are distinct from app commissions.
